field.name: parent
field.label: Reports to
field.help: Only positions of the job above this one and of higher rank are offered, using the job and grade as they are on this form.

field.name: headcount
field.label: Seats
field.help: How many people can hold this position. It cannot go below the number who hold it now.

field.name: status
field.label: Status
field.help: Open and filled follow the seats by themselves. Only freeze or unfreeze it here.

field.name: grade
field.label: Grade
field.help: Grades are set up in HR Configuration.

field.name: base_wage
field.label: Base wage
field.help: HR managers only. Used when the pay mode in HR defaults is by position or hybrid.

field.name: apply_to_holders
field.label: Apply a changed wage to the people in this position now
field.help: Starts new terms today for each person here (hybrid: except people with their own wage). Leave off to change only future hires and moves.
